dressCode: Smart casual. Men don't need a jacket, but trousers and closed shoes are required.
children: Babies and children under 7 aren't allowed.
bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website or by phone. From March to June and October to December it opens Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday for lunch and Friday and Saturday for lunch and dinner; July to September, dinner on Thursday too. Closed for the winter from 13 December 2026 to 9 March 2027.
cancellation: A credit card guarantees bookings of 1 to 5. Cancel in writing (info@martinberasategui.com) more than 48 hours ahead (96 hours for 6–10 guests, 10 days for 11–20), or pay €220 per person; the same applies to anyone who doesn't turn up.
groups: Groups of 6 or more prepay €220 per person, taken off the bill on the day.
